issues.description: The function construct_zero_state_prep_circuit has inconsistent return-type annotations across artifacts. In template_repository/msd.py the signature is annotated to return None (def construct_zero_state_prep_circuit(... ) -> None), but the problem statement (problem_statement.md) and the reference solution (solution_repository/msd.py) specify and implement the function as returning a stim.Circuit (-> stim.Circuit). This mismatch can confuse students about what the function should return and may lead to incorrect implementations or type-checking confusion.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the template function signature in template_repository/msd.py to match the problem specification and reference solution by annotating the return type as stim.Circuit (def construct_zero_state_prep_circuit(Hx: npt.NDArray[np.int8], offset: int = 0) -> stim.Circuit). Also ensure the function docstring's 'Returns' section and any inline comments reflect that a stim.Circuit is returned.
